seeds.title: Income-tax Act 1961 as amended by Finance Act 2011, with Finance Act 2011 and related legislation
seeds.edition_note: This is the 2011 compilation, not the original 1961 text or a complete 2000s snapshot. For an earlier year use only provisions with explicit historical text and effective-date support. Editorial commentary is not legislation.

seeds.title: Income-tax Rules 1962, Department of Revenue 2011 compilation
seeds.edition_note: 2011 compilation; check each rule and amendment date. Do not treat this as a current consolidated rulebook.

seeds.title: Finance Act 2020, Gazette of 27 March 2020 including First Schedule
seeds.edition_note: Enacted national Finance Act, including income-tax rates and amendments. Assessment year and financial year differ; match commencement and the relevant schedule part.

seeds.title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017, original enacted text
seeds.edition_note: Original 2017 Act, not a 2024 consolidation. Later amendments and commencement notifications must be read separately. Central GST alone does not establish the State GST component.

seeds.title: Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act 2017, original enacted text
seeds.edition_note: Original 2017 Act, not a 2024 consolidation. A charging provision is not the notified commodity or service rate schedule.

seeds.title: Central Goods and Services Tax Amendment Act 2018
seeds.edition_note: Amending Act; do not assume assent is commencement for provisions requiring notification.

seeds.title: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules 2017, Part A updated to 1 June 2021
seeds.edition_note: Consolidated rules to 1 June 2021. Establish historical applicability from dated amendments; no assumption that all rules applied in 2017 or after 2021.

seeds.title: Notification 1/2017 Central Tax (Rate), original goods rate schedules
seeds.edition_note: Original national CGST goods rate notification of 28 June 2017. It does not establish later amended rates, State GST or IGST rates.

seeds.title: Notification 9/2017 Central Tax, CGST commencement on 1 July 2017
seeds.edition_note: Commencement notification for specified CGST Act sections. Read the exact listed provisions; it is not a rate schedule.
